title: Tangrix ( Tangram Shift )
rules:
1. General Rules:
    • Participants register individually.
    • All seven pieces must be used; may be rotated or flipped, but not overlapped.
    • Pieces must stay within the puzzle area, and the target must be matched accurately.
    • No external help, reference images, or AI tools allowed.
    • Judges' decision is final.
  2. Time Limits:
    • Online challenge & offline knockout match: 3 minutes each. Final: Best of 3 challenges.
  3. Tie-Breaker:
    • Identical scores/times are broken with an extra Tangram challenge – fastest correct completion advances.
  4. Round 1 - Online Qualifier:
    • Participants get a digital Tangram puzzle with a target figure shown.
    • Match the target using all seven digital pieces within 3 minutes.
    • Completion time is recorded only if solved correctly.
    • Best times qualify for the offline round; ties broken by an extra challenge.
  5. Round 2 - Offline Challenge:
    • Each qualifier gets an identical physical Tangram set; target is revealed only at START.
    • First participant to correctly reproduce the target (verified by coordinator) wins the match.
    • If incorrect, the participant keeps trying until correct or time runs out.
judging:
• Round 1: Fastest correct completion ranks higher; top 16 qualify for offline round.
  • Round 2 (Quarter/Semi-finals): First to correctly reproduce the target (coordinator-verified) wins and advances.
  • Final: Best of 3 challenges – winner of 2 out of 3 is declared champion.
  • Ties broken by an extra challenge; outside help or AI tools leads disqualification.
